plugins.name: codello
plugins.description: Codello companion commands + skills: the codello:docs skill (answer how-to questions from codello.app/docs), the codello:cli skill (find/read sessions, map PTY ↔ agent ids, triage what's waiting), the codello:secrets skill (ask the user for a credential you need, without it entering the transcript), /codello:spawn (start titled sessions now, one per task), /codello:schedule (fire a pre-seeded session later), /codello:copy, the codello:quit skill (end the session when the task succeeds — "reply and quit"), the codello:done skill (report what the session's task ended as, so its row shows a check or an X), the codello:session-status skill (say the session is waiting on the user, when a background task or a hosted server would otherwise make it read as busy), plus the context-boundary set: /codello:handoff, /codello:resume, /codello:compact (in-place reset from a handoff), /codello:fresh (in-place reset with no handoff) and /codello:continue (after a /clear, pick up the conversation that ran in this session)
